findings.title: SQL injection in widget search
findings.why_vulnerable: The q query parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL LIKE clause with no parameterization or escaping.
findings.exploit_scenario: An anonymous user supplies q=%' OR '1'='1 to exfiltrate rows or chain to stacked queries.
findings.impact: Database read/exfiltration; potential write depending on driver settings.
findings.recommended_fix: Use parameterized queries / bound parameters; never build SQL by string concatenation.
findings.action_plan: Replace the f-string with a parameterized query and add a regression test.
findings.missing_tests: No test asserts the search query is parameterized.
findings.variants: Checked other src/api/*.py for string-built SQL; none else found here.
findings.live_verification_plan: With program authorization, send one benign sentinel value to /api/search and observe error/behavior; no automation, no DoS.

findings.title: Reflected XSS in legacy renderer
findings.vulnerable_flow: template.format(**data) renders untrusted data without encoding
findings.why_vulnerable: Untrusted data is interpolated into a template without contextual output encoding.
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker injects markup that executes in a victim's browser.
findings.variants: Only present in the legacy renderer.

findings.title: SSRF via user-controlled outbound fetch
findings.vulnerable_flow: user url -> fetch(url) -> http.get(url) with no allow-list visible in source
findings.why_vulnerable: A user-influenced URL reaches an outbound HTTP client with no source-visible allow-list.
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker points the URL at an internal metadata service to read credentials.
findings.impact: Access to internal services / cloud metadata; potential credential theft.
findings.recommended_fix: Enforce a strict egress allow-list and block internal ranges.
findings.action_plan: Add an allow-list check before http.get and a test for blocked internal hosts.
findings.variants: Single outbound helper; check callers of fetch().
findings.live_verification_plan: With authorization, issue one benign request to a controlled collaborator host; no scanning, no DoS.
